name: newsh2-229
summary: Shield drone (newsh2 frames 229-243): a small grey shield-shaped core split down the middle into two rounded armour lobes, with a red-orange light on each top corner, floating inside a ring of two polished grey arcs that turns clockwise frame by frame. Shape language: hard polished metal; the core's lobes are rounded plates either side of a cut-in centre seam, the arcs are round tubes of constant diameter with squared-off ends, the lights are glowing lenses set on the lobes.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: shield outline: flat across the top (row 8), straight sides, narrowing to a point at the bottom (rows 14-16)
rounded and raised: about 4-5 px above the ring's mid-plane at its highest, well above the arcs
one grey mid-tone (palette 9), polished metal; the sprite's white spots on it are sheen, not bumps
features.note: The body of the drone, centred in the ring.

traits: the core's left half reads as its own rounded lobe, highest in its middle and dipping toward the centre seam
round in section (a highlight band with darker edges), not a flat slab
features.note: The concept draws the two halves as separate armour plates; the baseline built them as two capsules.

traits: mirror of the left lobe: same shape and colour (the sprite draws it darker only because it is in shadow)
a dark 1 px seam down the core's middle from the top edge to just above the bottom point
cut in between the two lobes (a valley plus a narrow groove), not painted on
orange across the top row (2 px), red on the outer pixel below
a glowing emissive lens set on the lobe's top corner, slightly domed and raised so it reads from the game camera
features.note: The concept draws round glowing lenses in housings on the top corners.

traits: mirror of the left light: orange top row, red outer pixel below, raised domed lens
an arc of about 140 degrees around the core, radius about 8.5 px
round tube of constant diameter (about 4 px), about as tall as it is wide, no bulges
polished grey metal (palette 10); the white streaks on it are sheen
features.note: Turns with the ring 22.5 degrees a frame (one model per frame).

traits: mirror of the left arc across the ring's centre, with the same gaps between the two arcs at top and bottom
